errors.text_span: + SFT on $D_0$ (light orange with white horizontal hatching)
errors.evidence: In the figure, the + SFT on D0 bars use horizontal white hatching over a pale orange fill, but the description’s wording is acceptable; however, the major issue is elsewhere: the first three conditions are not all distinguished by white hatching patterns that differ as described—this claim is partly okay. No error here if taken literally.

errors.text_span: "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" bar represents the tallest value in the entire chart at approximately 85
errors.evidence: The tallest bars are actually the + SFT on D0, D1 bars for LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B at about 84–85, but the chart’s highest visible value is around 84.5; the stated 85 is an overestimate. More importantly, the description implies a single tallest bar, whereas two bars appear tied or nearly tied at the top.
The tallest bar is slightly below 85, around 84–85 depending on reading; the value is approximate and not clearly wrong, so this is at most a minor numerical mismatch.
The description does not mention that the bars are patterned with diagonal or horizontal white hatching as a key visual feature in the chart legend and bars.
